what: Card stack: cards stick 20px from the top of the screen one after another (or, when taller than the screen, once their bottom edge touches). While the next card rises by its own height to cover it, the card in front turns alternately −2.67° and +2.67°, tilts back 40°, and shrinks to .7x, receding into 1200px perspective. Once fully covered, the front card hides

duration.Lying down: Scroll where the next card rises by the height of the previous card

options.tilt: Rotation angle (°, even cards −, odd +), default 2.67156
